## 🌐 How to Access

### Option 1: Direct File Access (OneDrive Sync)
1. Ensure OneDrive is syncing to your local machine
2. Navigate to: `C:\Users\ahussain\OneDrive - WAGEWORKS, INC\ASIF\RA-Domain-Analysis`
3. Double-click `index.html` to open in browser

### Option 2: OneDrive Web Viewer
1. Open OneDrive in web browser
2. Navigate to: `ASIF/RA-Domain-Analysis`
3. Click on `index.html` (OneDrive will preview HTML)

### Option 3: Share with Network Users
1. Right-click on `RA-Domain-Analysis` folder in OneDrive
2. Select "Share" → "Anyone with the link"
3. Copy link and share with stakeholders
4. Recipients can view in browser or download folder

## 🛠️ Maintenance

### Updating Content
1. Edit HTML files in `RA-Domain-Analysis/` folder
2. OneDrive auto-syncs changes
3. Stakeholders with link see updated version immediately
4. Version history preserved in OneDrive

### Customization
- **Colors:** Edit CSS variables in `css/main.css` (lines 1-15)
- **Logo:** Add company logo to `assets/` and update `index.html`
- **Footer:** Update contact info in `<footer>` section
